source: Toprank Review Academy (TRA) Nursing Module – Complete Handout

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which gland secretes an alkaline fluid that neutralizes vaginal acidity?
questions.rationale: Bartholin's (paravaginal) glands secrete alkaline fluid; Skene's glands secrete lubricating mucus.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, External Genitalia (PDF p. 186)
questions.quote: Secretes alkaline substance responsible for neutralizing the acidity of the vagina

questions.subject: NP II
questions.topic: Care of Mother During Labor and Birth
questions.stem: Which structure is a common site for episiotomy?
questions.rationale: The fourchette, the posterior joining of the labia, is a common episiotomy site.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, External Genitalia (PDF p. 186)
questions.quote: Common site for episiotomy

questions.subject: NP II
questions.topic: Care of Mother During Labor and Birth
questions.stem: Which part of the uterus is most commonly cut in a cesarean section?
questions.rationale: The isthmus (lower segment) is most commonly incised for cesarean birth.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Uterine Anatomy (PDF p. 187)
questions.quote: Portion of the uterus that is most commonly cut when a fetus is born by a Cesarean section

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Where does fertilization usually occur?
questions.rationale: The ampulla is the longest part of the tube and the common site of fertilization and ectopic pregnancy.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Fallopian Tube (PDF p. 187)
questions.quote: Common site for fertilization; common site for ectopic pregnancy

questions.subject: NP II
questions.topic: Care of Mother with Complications of Childbearing
questions.stem: Which ectopic pregnancy site is MOST dangerous?
questions.rationale: The interstitial portion is the most dangerous site for ectopic pregnancy (risk of massive hemorrhage).
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Fallopian Tube (PDF p. 188)
questions.quote: Most dangerous site for ectopic pregnancy

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which male structure is the site of sperm maturation?
questions.rationale: The epididymis conducts sperm to the vas deferens and is the site of sperm maturation.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Male Internal Genitalia (PDF p. 188)
questions.quote: Site of maturation of the sperm

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which hormone surge triggers ovulation?
questions.rationale: Peaking estrogen triggers the LH surge, which coincides with ovulation.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Menstrual Cycle (PDF p. 189)
questions.quote: Coincides with ovulation

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which phase of the menstrual cycle is constant at 14 days?
questions.rationale: The luteal phase is always about 14 days; the proliferative phase varies.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Menstrual Cycle (PDF p. 189)
questions.quote: Remains constant: always 14 days in length

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: A woman has a 32-day cycle. On about which day does she ovulate?
questions.rationale: The luteal phase is 14 days, so ovulation is about 14 days before menses: 32 − 14 = day 18.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Menstrual Cycle (PDF p. 189)
questions.quote: Remains constant: always 14 days in length

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: The developing baby is called an embryo during which period?
questions.rationale: Zygote under 2 weeks, embryo 2 to under 8 weeks, fetus 8 weeks to birth.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Terminologies (PDF p. 190)
questions.quote: 2 to < 8 weeks aog

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which is a PRESUMPTIVE sign of pregnancy?
questions.rationale: Presumptive signs are subjective: amenorrhea, nausea, breast changes, quickening. Tests and ballottement are probable; FHT is positive.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Signs of Pregnancy (PDF p. 190)
questions.quote: Least indicative of pregnancy

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which is a POSITIVE sign of pregnancy?
questions.rationale: Positive signs: fetal heart tones, fetal movement felt by examiner, fetus on ultrasound.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Signs of Pregnancy (PDF p. 191)
questions.quote: Fetal Heart Tone

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Bluish-purple discoloration of the vagina in pregnancy is:
questions.rationale: Chadwick's sign is bluish vaginal discoloration; Goodell's is cervical softening; Hegar's is lower uterine softening.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Signs of Pregnancy (PDF p. 191)
questions.quote: Bluish-purple discoloration of the vagina

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: At 20 weeks, where is the fundus usually found?
questions.rationale: 12 weeks: symphysis; 16 weeks: halfway; 20 weeks: umbilicus; 36 weeks: xiphoid.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Landmarks (PDF p. 191)
questions.quote: 20 weeks Level of umbilicus

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: When does hCG usually peak in pregnancy?
questions.rationale: hCG peaks at about 10 weeks AOG (2 months).
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Probable Signs (PDF p. 191)
questions.quote: Peak level of hCG = 10 weeks Age of Gestation or 2 months

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which nursing measure helps morning sickness?
questions.rationale: Dry crackers, small frequent meals, less fatty food, ice chips, and ambulation help.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Presumptive Signs (PDF p. 190)
questions.quote: Provide dry, unsalted Crackers

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Why should the woman void before Leopold's maneuvers?
questions.rationale: An empty bladder promotes comfort and keeps fetal contour from being obscured.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Leopold's Maneuver (PDF p. 192)
questions.quote: Let patient void before performing Leopold’s Maneuver

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which Leopold's maneuver locates the fetal back?
questions.rationale: The second maneuver locates the fetal back, where FHT is best heard.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Leopold's Maneuver (PDF p. 192)
questions.quote: Locates the fetal back

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Which Leopold's maneuver determines whether the presenting part is engaged?
questions.rationale: The third maneuver checks the part at the inlet and engagement.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Leopold's Maneuver (PDF p. 192)
questions.quote: Determines if the presenting part is engaged or not engaged.

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: During the fourth Leopold's maneuver, which way does the nurse face?
questions.rationale: In the first three maneuvers the nurse faces the head; in the fourth, the foot of the bed.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Leopold's Maneuver (PDF p. 192)
questions.quote: during the last maneuver, the nurse will be facing the foot part of the bed

questions.subject: NP II
questions.topic: Care of Mother During Labor and Birth
questions.stem: Which fetal attitude presents the smallest head diameter?
questions.rationale: Full flexion presents the suboccipitobregmatic, the smallest diameter.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Types of Attitude (PDF p. 193)
questions.quote: Present the suboccipito-bregmatic (smallest) diameter

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: A woman at 30 weeks becomes dizzy lying supine. Which position helps?
questions.rationale: The uterus compresses the vena cava (supine hypotensive syndrome); left lateral relieves it.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Physiological Changes (PDF p. 193)
questions.quote: Position of Choice: Left lateral/Sim's position

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: Why does physiologic anemia occur in pregnancy?
questions.rationale: Hemodilution from increased plasma volume causes physiologic anemia; iron needs rise.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Hematologic Changes (PDF p. 193)
questions.quote: Presence of hemodilution in response to increase in plasma volume during pregnancy

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: In which position is a pregnant woman's BP LOWEST?
questions.rationale: BP is highest sitting, intermediate supine, and lowest left lateral; rest 15 minutes first.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Prenatal Clinic (PDF p. 192)
questions.quote: Left Lateral: Lowest reading among the three positions

questions.subject: NP II
questions.stem: By how much does cardiac output increase in pregnancy?
questions.rationale: Cardiac output increases 25–50% and heart rate about 10 bpm.
questions.source: TRA Nursing Module, Physiological Changes (PDF p. 193)
questions.quote: Cardiac output increases significantly by 25% to 50%
